title: Weeping Bear Cascade
description: A large stylized green wooden bear head with a black void eye containing a yellow star dominates the composition. Blue smoke rises from its head while a yellow hand with red nails and tattoos pours water from a blue teddy bear, creating cascading waterfalls that flow into pools below containing smaller crying bear heads.
prompt: Surreal painting of a large green wooden bear head with one black void eye containing a yellow star, blue swirling smoke rising from its head with red roses, a yellow hand with red nails and purple tattoos holding a small blue teddy bear that pours water creating multiple waterfalls, smaller crying bear heads in blue and red liquid pools below surrounded by flowers and white polka dots on a black background
